title: GitHub Services Experiencing Disruption
summary: GitHub is currently investigating reports of performance issues affecting some of its services. The incident was reported on August 26, 2026, at 15:09 UTC, and updates are being provided via their status page.
key_points: GitHub is experiencing performance disruptions in some services.
The incident was reported on August 26, 2026, at 15:09 UTC.
Users can subscribe to updates via email, SMS, Slack, webhooks, Atom Feed, or RSS Feed.
GitHub is actively investigating the issue and providing status updates.
